unexecuted_policy_history: Earlier independently reviewed .95/.025/.025 distribution was a prospective unexecuted suggestion. Root superseded it before any case/parser/model/native/scorer measurement and before source/case freeze. It is not candidate calibration or a measured policy comparison.

mathematical_review.assumptions: Complete finite canonical probability vector E,C,N; source-provided original logit winner w and valid independently certified label y. For generic source tensor, preserve source C,N,E raw-logit tie order rather than recomputing from rounded probabilities.
mathematical_review.action: Swap p_w and p_y; other component unchanged. Abstention/agreement raw unchanged. Certificate class wins any final maximum tie for derived decision only.
mathematical_review.conditional_true_certificate_NLL_delta: NLL(after,truth=y)-NLL(before,truth=y) = log(p_y/p_w) <= 0 for positive probabilities, extended by limits at zero.
mathematical_review.scope: Guarantee relative to exactly the same raw context readout only. No guarantee relative to full-source/lexical contexts, and no statement that transposed probabilities are calibrated.
mathematical_review.wrong_certificate: When truth is the prior winner and source masses differ, both Brier and NLL worsen; if truth is outside the swapped pair they may remain invariant. A wrong source certificate remains a soundness failure even if proper scores are invariant.
mathematical_review.tie_nuance: Exact maximum ties can change a hard decision without changing probabilities. That is an explicit derived source-certified tie rule, never raw-T1 equivalence.

engineering_acceptance_scope: Only the12 authored CC0 full-grammar formal financial sources. All12correct,4perclass,+2correct versus full_raw and Brier/NLL nonincrease against allfour controls remain frozen. full_raw>10 means prospective ceiling rejection. Null native versus lexical/full verified results cannot support native causal gain. No benchmark accuracy/generalization/ClaimBench/promotion claim.
required_source_conditions: Every supplied clause and qualifier parsed and globally consistent; unsupported/ambiguous/conflicting/cyclic sources abstain.
Exact rational units, entity, period and metric bindings; formulas must be supplied source constraints, never financial-name assumptions.
Set cardinality worlds integral and nonnegative over a declared common universe.
Neutral certificates include feasible true and false worlds satisfying all source constraints, never a retrieval miss.
Required dependency coverage uses only source+claim and complete selected clauses under512 actual tokens; no IDs, oracle labels, or gold evidence selection.
